open_meteo_archive.label: ARCHIVE (Open-Meteo historical archive, reanalysis/NWP based)
open_meteo_archive.finding: The archive's gridded rain over the window is 141 mm (city mean; 150 mm at its wettest point, peak 20 mm/h) against about 447 mm at Santacruz observatory from the reported gauge totals over the same hours. The model is driven by its rain, so this run shows what a nowcast fed only by such a product would have seen — the case for wiring the BMC's own rain gauges into the pilot.

proposal_examples: Milan Subway (Santacruz) (P V Avsare Marg (Milan Subway road)): waterlogging risk 2 (10–30 cm), deep water in about 90 min; no detour on the city network that avoids flagged roads — propose closing to small vehicles with officer judgement on site.

Ambulance (108) note — Milan Subway (Santacruz) (P V Avsare Marg (Milan Subway road)): passable for about 90 min more; no detour avoiding flagged roads. Nearest major hospital: Cooper Hospital (2.0 km).

Live-wire hazard — Milan Subway (Santacruz) (P V Avsare Marg (Milan Subway road)): waterlogging risk 2 (10–30 cm). Propose asking the area's power distribution utility to inspect and, where needed, isolate street-light and overhead supply along this road.

Andheri Subway (Andheri East approach, Sahar Road) (Sahar Road (Andheri Subway approach)): waterlogging risk 2 (10–30 cm), deep water in about 90 min; no detour on the city network that avoids flagged roads — propose closing to small vehicles with officer judgement on site.

advisory_draft.en: Traffic advisory (draft): waterlogging is likely within the next 120 minutes at these places: Milan Subway (Santacruz); Andheri Subway (Andheri East approach, Sahar Road); Byculla (Dr Ambedkar Road, Jijamata Udyan). Please avoid these roads if you can. Do not touch electric poles or wires in standing water. Emergency: 112; BMC disaster control: 1916; ambulance (108).
advisory_draft.mr: वाहतूक सूचना (मसुदा): पुढील 120 मिनिटांत या ठिकाणी पाणी साचण्याची शक्यता आहे: मिलन सबवे (सांताक्रूझ); अंधेरी सबवे (अंधेरी पूर्व बाजू, सहार मार्ग); भायखळा (डॉ. आंबेडकर मार्ग, जिजामाता उद्यान). शक्य असल्यास हे रस्ते टाळा. साचलेल्या पाण्यात विजेचे खांब किंवा तारांना स्पर्श करू नका. आपत्कालीन क्रमांक: 112; बृहन्मुंबई महानगरपालिका आपत्ती नियंत्रण: 1916; रुग्णवाहिका (108).
advisory_draft.hi: यातायात सलाह (मसौदा): अगले 120 मिनट में इन जगहों पर जलभराव की आशंका है: मिलन सबवे (सांताक्रूज़); अंधेरी सबवे; भायखळा (डॉ. आंबेडकर मार्ग, जिजामाता उद्यान)। हो सके तो इन सड़कों से बचें। जमा पानी में बिजली के खंभों या तारों को न छुएँ। आपातकालीन: 112; बीएमसी आपदा नियंत्रण: 1916; एम्बुलेंस (108)।

imd_gauge_flat_sensitivity.label: SENSITIVITY — the same OBSERVED totals, flat within each window
imd_gauge_flat_sensitivity.finding: The same totals without the archive's timing: the drains' design rates (12.5–50 mm/h of runoff) are crossed by the bursts, not by the window means, so the timing within the hour — what a live gauge feed adds — moves the result.

honesty: News reports name places, not every street, and the network has 86 arterial segments: a flag with no report is not called a false alarm, and an off-network report is listed but not scored. A report's time is its publication time, so a lead before it is an upper bound. Station positions are approximate and the 15-minute shape is modelled.
